Son Kills Father During Assault on Mother and Sister in Karnal

In Karnal, a minor son has been reported to have killed his father. The incident occurred when the father was allegedly assaulting the mother and sister. The son reportedly used a rod to strike the father. Following the incident, the son transported the father's body to the hospital himself, and police are investigating the matter.
